Across workloads including qLDPC surgery, the research reports schedule-derived resource estimates reconciling with established independent models, providing independent technical support for the materiality of qLDPC/CUDA-Q Logical as a fault-tolerant software pathway.

This supports the existing INFQ catalyst/thesis context around its September CUDA-Q Logical integration without independently verifying Infleqtion's company-specific hardware milestone or commercial economics.
